## Task and run records

Follow benchmarks/README.md. Include the fixture and skill commit, date, Codex
version, model/effort, environment, prompts, limits, and invocation evidence.

## Conditions and controls

Paired or unpaired? Number and order of attempts? Was the skill unavailable to
baseline? Which instructions and other skills were active?

## Results and evidence

Report every attempt, acceptance checks, metrics, elapsed time, and available
usage. Link sanitized artifacts, diffs, transcripts, and scoring rationale.

## Failures and limitations

Include human corrections, timeouts, exclusions, unavailable measurements, and
whether scoring was blinded. Do not upload private source or credentials.
